description: Fires when the budget guard (reference-library/src/gradebook/logs.py:budget_guard_tripped, emitted from toy-world's live run loop when a call would breach the per-run cap) trips 3 or more times within a rolling 5-minute window. This is a discrete failure-event stream - each trip is one WARN log carrying augmentloop.failure.class=budget_guard_tripped - which is what logs and log-based alerts are for and what a metrics counter expresses badly. Filter matches the structured attribute, not the log body text, so it is immune to the warning message's wording changing. Rationale for N=3 in 5m, not N=1: a single trip is the budget cap doing its job (a run correctly stopped before overspending) and is not on its own an incident. Three or more trips inside 5 minutes means either the per-run cap is set too low for real usage, or something is retrying against an already-exhausted budget in a loop - either is worth a human looking at it. The 3-in-5m burst shape mirrors an existing rule on this account for a different failure class (an unrelated LLM error-burst rule), so it is a proven threshold pattern here, not a first guess. Threshold implementation note: op=above is strictly greater-than (confirmed against that same reference rule's description, 'exceeds 3'), so target is set to 2, not 3, to make the rule actually fire at 3+ trips rather than requiring 4+. Query verified live on 2026-07-26: POST /api/v5/query_range with this exact compositeQuery against real budget_guard_tripped logs (emitted through the same OTLP LoggingHandler path toy-world/__main__.py wires up) returned count()=4 for 4 emitted trips inside the query window. One deployment note found while verifying: a brand-new attribute key is not queryable in SigNoz's log search expression until at least one matching log has been ingested (a fresh key returns 'not found' from the search-expression parser before that) - not a bug, just an ordering constraint to know about when testing this rule from a cold stack.

annotations.description: Gradebook budget guard tripped {{$value}} times in the last 5 minutes - 3 or more trips in that window is the repeated-trip threshold that needs a human look.
